name: png-sprite-tools
description: Browser tools for game and UI PNG assets: trim transparent padding from one PNG or a batch (with exact padding), and slice a sprite sheet into individual PNG frames, then wire the results into your project.

description_i18n.en: Browser tools for game and UI PNG assets: trim transparent padding from one PNG or a batch (with exact padding), and slice a sprite sheet into individual PNG frames, then wire the results into your project.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向游戏与界面 PNG 素材的浏览器工具：裁掉单张或批量 PNG 的透明边并加精确留白，把精灵图切成单帧 PNG，再把结果接入你的项目。
